patterns: APPSC overwhelmingly asks Veeresalingam one-liners: Vivekavardhini (1874) founder/year, Satihita Bodhini for women, Hitakarini Samaj, first girls' school, Rajasekhara Charitra = first Telugu novel, 'father of Telugu renaissance'.

Other recurring APPSC facts: Bhogam abolition = Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu; Kanyasulkam = Gurajada; Prakasika (1896) = Gurajada; Vyavaharika Samaj = Gidugu; Kasiyatra Charitra = Enugula Veeraswamayya.
Shapes are direct 'who founded/wrote' and simple correct-pair questions; traps swap journals among Veeresalingam, Kokkonda and Venkataratnam Naidu.
Watch conflicting keys: G2 2025 Vivekavardhini (D. Rangacharyulu), Brahmo Samaj in combined AP keyed to Veeresalingam.
App MCQs go far deeper (Kanyasulkam characters, dictionaries, missions, MIM/Dutch trivia) and sometimes contradict each other on 'first political journal'.
